program: Wingless prospective validation of the R26 raw-motif-churn control
question: Does the sole R26 supported feature form—raw motif churn per interval byte with no gate or weighting—prospectively rank productive adaptation intervals above zero-gain intervals on a wholly new fifth manifest?
hypothesis: Use only fifth manifest bcd603af361f4882961346fa39f6cad0c1be7ea8cced9685c882be83394fd835. Preserve the R25/R26 leave-one-domain-out construction, 15,819 non-target training bytes per arm, 256 motifs, 582-byte sealed evaluation slice, 872-byte adaptation reservoir, and the same domain-specific budget grids. Freeze the only control under test to R26 cell 0: for every adjacent interval whose motif entry+exit count is >0, raw_churn_signal=(motif_entry_count+motif_exit_count)/interval_bytes. Determine all interval scores before opening sealed evaluation bytes. Then label intervals PRODUCTIVE if actual exact-hit gain>0, ZERO_GAIN if gain==0, and NEGATIVE if gain<0. No baseline-disagreement gate, support weight, consistency weight, candidate allocation, or fifth-manifest outcome may modify the signal. This is prospective validation only and does not install the control into an allocator.

supported_form.signal: raw motif entry+exit count / interval bytes

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_contract.interval_inclusion: all adjacent intervals with motif_entry_count+motif_exit_count>0, determined before evaluation labels

classification_rules.supported: valid, at least one PRODUCTIVE and one ZERO_GAIN churn interval exist, mean productive raw_churn_signal > mean zero-gain signal, and productive-vs-zero pairwise AUC >=0.75
classification_rules.mixed: valid and either label diversity is insufficient for the preregistered AUC test or the direction is positive with AUC>0.5 but below 0.75
classification_rules.negative: valid with sufficient label diversity but raw motif churn does not rank productive intervals above zero-gain intervals
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, fifth-manifest/source identity, split, budget grid, interval inclusion, frozen signal identity, label isolation, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter fifth-manifest identities, budgets, motif capacity, interval inclusion, raw-churn signal, label definitions, AUC threshold, evaluator, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: test whether raw churn would have avoided the R23 allocation failure across previously sealed manifests before any live allocator revision

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: stop structural churn reweighting and investigate training-only outcome mechanisms instead
